no_api_findings.finding: The documented std library has no ZIP archive or entry decoder. std::fs::read returns raw bytes and std::io::Read is a byte-source trait; neither interprets ZIP headers, entry names, or compressed contents. No documented format-aware bundled API was available to run against the valid ZIP control.

limit: This covers the documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library; crates and native system libraries are separate.
